interpretation.statement: Explicitly stating the existing type-tagged action serialization crossed the natural X4-T1 envelope gate: accepted turns rose from 0/32 to 19/32 and the official MCP boundary was reached 35 times.
interpretation.residual_bottleneck: All remaining rejected C1 turns used parser-compatible type-tagged actions but supplied 6-12 actions, exceeding the unchanged max_actions=5 limit that was still not model-visible.
interpretation.task_completion_limit: C1 still ended at the 32-turn budget with no terminal answer and no checkout change; therefore schema clarification alone did not establish task completion.
interpretation.causal_limit: This is one predeclared local contrast. It supports the local gate diagnosis but is not an occurrence-rate estimate or a cross-system causal ranking.
